ann.t: General Updates — Gravita India Limited has informed the Exchange about the financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026.
Outcome of Board Meeting — Gravita India Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
Acquisition — The Company has approved the subscription to the Rights Issue of Rashtriya Metal Industries Limited (RMIL) by subscribing to the equity shares offered under the Rights Issue.
Outcome of Board Meeting — Gravita India Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended Jun 30, 2026.
Action(s) taken or orders passed — Gravita India Limited has informed the Exchange about Action(s) taken or orders passed
Change in Auditors — Gravita India Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Change in Auditors of the company.
Outcome of Board Meeting — Gravita India Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended March 31, 2026.
Resignation of Independent director — GRAVITA INDIA LIMITED has informed the Exchange about Resignation of Independent director.
Resignation — Gravita India Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Resignation of Mr Vijay Kumar Pareek as Other of the company w.e.f. March 31, 2026.
Resignation — Gravita India Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Resignation of Mr Satish Kumar Agrawal as Non- Executive Independent Director of the company w.e.f. March 18, 2026.
Outcome of Board Meeting — Gravita India Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended December 31, 2025.
